subject: prd/argus-boundary-enforcement
statement: The attribution gate shall determine Argus authorship from a signal that is **produced by construction** on every commit a drive's work is landed as — never chosen by the model, never hand-added — such that no drive path can land a commit whose Argus authorship is underivable; the derivation shall be **forgery-resistant in strength**, so a misbehaving or injected drive cannot forge, replay, or omit the signal to change the derived class; and it shall continue to require **no mutable platform badge and no ambient credentials at CI evaluation time**.
rationale: closes the latent-signal gap (a real produced signal, not a hand-seeded fixture) and §7 Q1's evade direction, while preserving FR-11's badge-independent/credential-free-at-CI property; the *property* is required at DoD, the *mechanism* (producer site, forgery-resistance construction) is design-owned
fit_criterion: on a corpus that includes a **live drive-produced** commit (not only hand-seeded fixtures), the gate derives that commit as Argus by its produced signal; a **forged / replayed / stripped** signal on a protected-path diff does not flip the derived class (never Argus→human to evade, never human→Argus to frame); the derivation runs in the CI deployment context with no ambient credential and reads no mutable badge
